description: Grow the lot's buildable size (byte index into VMBuildableAreaInfo.BuildableSizes) and/or stories (0..3). Size-down and no-op are server-rejected. Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side; server-side Owner via VMTSOAvatarPermissions.Owner). A transaction is required: the server calls GlobalLink.PerformTransaction for baseCost + roomieCost; if funds are insufficient the resize is silently cancelled. Effect: vm.TSOState.Size packed field changes; visible via query-lot.size_tiles / floors. Cost: VMBuildableAreaInfo.CalculateBaseCost(oldTotal, newTotal) + CalculateRoomieCost per roommate. Wire: VMNetChangeLotSizeCmd { LotSize, LotStories }.
call_signatures: cf $CF change-lot-size --lot_size <byte_0..255> --lot_stories <0..3>                                   # owner-only; lot_size indexes VMBuildableAreaInfo.BuildableSizes
common_mistakes: lot_size out of [0,255] or lot_stories out of [0,3] → ok:false.
lot_size is an INDEX into VMBuildableAreaInfo.BuildableSizes, not a tile count.
perception_hints: Am I the owner? perception.lot.owner_is_me — architecture ops are owner-only
Your position (to anchor where to build): perception.avatar.position.x, .y (tile coords — arch ops accept tile coords directly, unlike walk-to)
Walls/floors are NOT exposed in perception — use query-architecture (test helper) if you need pre/post state
refuse_conditions: caller is not lot owner → returns ok:false with 'caller is not lot owner (owner_id=..., me=...)'
required tile coords (x, y) missing → returns ok:false with '<verb> requires x, y ...'
width/height/length <= 0 where specified → returns ok:false with specific bounds error
